title: Funny Pickleball Shirt, Doctor's Orders Rx Pickleball Take Daily, Pickleball Gift for Players
description:
The prescription everyone is happy to fill. Take pickleball daily, repeat as needed, unlimited refills.

Who it's for:
- Players who say pickleball is the best medicine
- Friends and family looking for a gift for a keen player
- Nurses, doctors and health fans who love the sport

About the design:
A prescription-label layout with a coral Rx, navy and teal lettering and a gentle sign-off: 'Dr. Dink, not a real doctor'.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Pickleball prescription label reading Rx Pickleball, take daily, repeat as needed on a white tee.
